scope: Numerical interoperability only. Does not determine the correct pixel frame, manufacturer accuracy or vignette model.

rawtherapee.scope: Compiled, pinned upstream RawTherapee interpolation/setup/factor methods adapted only for standalone IO; numeric radial-factor comparison, not frame or optical verification. Reference GPL source remains in ignored Build and is not linked into or distributed with LensDock.

darktable46.scope: Compiled pinned darktable 4.6 legacy v1 Sony setup and linear-spline source with standalone IO. Its squared-transmission vignette result must not be described as the default v2 response. No product linkage, pixel/frame or optical-accuracy claim.
darktable46.algorithmVersion: legacy-v1 (_init_coeffs_md_v1), retained for existing edits; not 4.6 default v2

nativeFactorConvention: Interpolate distortion and channel factors separately, then multiply; matches the pinned RawTherapee methods for the sampled source.

interpretationCorrection.reason: The earlier adapter selected the first Sony branch in the source, inside _init_coeffs_md_v1. reload_defaults selects v2 for available embedded metadata. Measured legacy values remain valid; the implied default-version interpretation does not.
